model: Arsenal 7° Titanium Gravel - Bikepacking Frame Set
description:
Named for the ultimate weapons platform of the skies, the Arsenal 7° stands as the most flexible, purposeful, and relentlessly capable gravel, bikepacking, and expedition machine ever engineered. Born from Airborne’s uncompromising dedication to precision manufacturing and real-world adventure testing, this flagship platform is purpose-built to dominate every mission — from nimble, spirited gravel escapes on technical singletrack to unsupported multi-week expeditions across continents. With its revolutionary geometry range and titanium’s legendary ride quality, the Arsenal 7° doesn’t just adapt to the terrain — it conquers it.

Equipped with the groundbreaking RideDNA™ adjustable headset system and the patent-pending VectorLoc™ adjustable dropout system, the Arsenal 7° lets you instantly transform its character — from a razor-sharp, short-wheelbase gravel racer to a long-haul, ultra-stable expedition platform that carries heavy loads with confidence-inspiring poise.

Key features:

Helix ™ 13 position adjustable headset system — modify head tube angle for optimized stability, agility, or all-terrain confidence. Adjust to match your preferred riding style or normalize geometry for a longer suspension fork.

VectorLoc ™ adjustable dropout system — 6 positions let you tune chainstay length, tire clearance, and frame geometry; from aggressive gravel to long-haul relaxed geometry, delivering the perfect balance for any mission.

Phantom DLC ™ Hyper Black Lifetime Scratch Proof Coating

#####TOP SECRET FEATURE##### To be announced 11/15/26

Premium double-butted 3Al-2.5V titanium tubing construction — natural compliance, superior vibration damping, and lifetime durability.

SLM 3D Printed Grade 5 (6Al/4V) Titanium, Vacuum Annealed frame components: Hyperbolic Paraboloid Head Tube, VectorLoc™ Dropouts, Chain Stay Mono-Yoke, Delta Strake™ Seat Stay Stabilizers.

Generous tire clearance — up to 62mm (2.44"), ready for fast-rolling gravel tires or high-volume 29” MTB adventure setups.
